intervalUncertainty: Approx +/-2 frames per contact endpoint: interval bound +/-0.16s at25fps; +/-0.133s at30fps. Manual estimates, not certified motion capture.

decelerationObservation.limitation: Image plane speed, not world m/s; perspective and vertical motion prohibit unique 3D drag fit.

groundMovement.method: Apple Vision ankle midpoint, court floor homography, feet overlay manually checked
groundMovement.limitation: Not COM or statistical CI; airborne feet and homography error; cannot uniquely determine acceleration or maximum sprint speed.

model.limitation: Rhythm approximation. Horizontal drag coefficient and acceleration are engineering calibration choices, not uniquely measured physiological/aerodynamic constants. Fixed game fixtures are not exact 3D reconstruction of these clips. Contact-to-contact video intervals must not be equated to time-to-floor.
